messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE — Tenant: ZenithPay (dedicated/vpc: eu-central-1) — anomaly detected on model redwood-13b@v2.0.1 profile=q5_0. Live customer reports of low-quality and hallucinations. Alert: INC-20260315-ZEN-02

sre-oncall: ack. tagging ml-eng-raj and eng-runtime-ana. creating incident thread. brief TL;DR: single tenant impact but user-facing.

ml-eng-raj: digging into evals now. automated drift detection flagged answer_coherence down ~30% vs baseline for ZenithPay prompts. The change window aligns with profile q5_0 rollout to dedicated pools at 2026-03-15T04:05Z.

eng-runtime-ana: pulling runtime traces for tenant=zenithpay. observed difference in tokenization+embedding mismatch leading to higher eos token rates for long transactions. sample logs:
```
[2026-03-15T04:07:21Z] tenant=zenithpay model=redwood-13b@v2.0.1 profile=q5_0 req_id=xyz latency=120ms eos_rate=0.12
[2026-03-15T04:07:22Z] tenant=others model=redwood-13b@v2.0.1 profile=q5_0 req_id=abc latency=118ms eos_rate=0.02
```
looks like q5_0 truncates more aggressively for this tenant's payloads.

support-omar: CS received inbound: "Invoices are being summarized incorrectly, critical errors". They put a temporary pause on prod calls. cs-katie coordinating.

cs-katie: contacting ZenithPay CSM and support lead. Want clear customer-facing line "we're investigating and will revert if needed". please confirm revert steps and ETA.

ml-eng-raj: recommended immediate tenant-scoped revert to last-good config: redwood-13b@v2.0.0 with profile=q4_2. We'll use tenant pin + isolated backup pool. Proposed steps:
1) isolate ZenithPay to iso-eu-central-1 (backup) to prevent cross-tenant exposure
2) pin model+profile to v2.0.0/q4_2 for tenant
3) run fast smoke suite and sanity-check SLOs
4) monitor for 30-60m then propose to un-isolate
Notes: we need infra approval for peering to backup pool because ZenithPay is VPC-dedicated.

ops-helen: confirmed backup pool has VPC peering in place. I'll enable temporary route and hold any auto-rollouts for eu-central-1.

eng-runtime-ana: executing tenant routing and pin now:
```
rdwctl route set --tenant zenithpay --pool iso-eu-central-1 --reason "regression q5_0"
rdwctl model pin --tenant zenithpay --model redwood-13b@v2.0.0 --profile q4_2
```
deploy-bot: Job 5037 queued: tenant-pin-zenithpay -> applying config. CI: passed.

deploy-bot: Job 5037 status -> SUCCESS.

eng-runtime-ana: route set returned: {"status":"ok","tenant":"zenithpay","to_pool":"iso-eu-central-1"} 
pin returned: {"status":"ok","tenant":"zenithpay","model":"redwood-13b@v2.0.0","profile":"q4_2"}

sre-oncall: running quick smoke via internal eval harness against tenant-scoped endpoint.
```
curl -s -X POST https://int-api/redwood/generate -d '{"tenant":"zenithpay","prompt":"Summarize this invoice..."}' | jq -r .text
```
sample: concise, correct. no hallucination in sample.

ml-eng-raj: automated check: 60 prompts -> answer_coherence returned to baseline within 5% variance. flag removed for ZenithPay.

cs-katie: messaging ZenithPay: "We have reverted you to previous model/profile and isolated traffic to a backup pool while we validate. We'll monitor and follow up with RCA within 48 hours." they asked for logs slice; shared sanitized logs.

ops-helen: applied temporary guardrails: disabled auto-rollout for dedicated pools in eu-central-1 and added a gating rule requiring a canary on a representative tenant set before region-wide rollouts.

eng-runtime-ana: note for follow-up: tenant pin uses cached routing entries; if we later re-enable q5_0 we should ensure tenant-specific overrides are respected. opened ticket: https://tickets.internal/INC-20260315-ZEN-02 to track.

prod-manager-sam: assign follow-ups: ML lead (ml-eng-raj) RCA, Runtime lead (eng-runtime-ana) verify pin/unpin automation, Ops (ops-helen) rollout gating, CS (cs-katie) customer communication and credit if needed. Postmortem in 72h.

ml-eng-raj: preliminary hypothesis: q5_0 introduced a new per-channel quantization schedule optimized for median prompts; edge tenants with long, numeric-heavy contexts (ZenithPay) fall into low-fidelity region. Plan: reproduce locally with ZenithPay prompt set, run quant-sweep, and if confirmed, create q5_0_patch with adjusted scale params or remove q5_0 from auto-rollouts.

eng-runtime-ana: handing over monitoring to ops-helen and eng-runtime-ana (overnight) for 2h watch. sre-oncall will log incident as mitigated once stability confirmed.

sre-oncall: marking incident as MITIGATED (tenant isolated and pinned). impact limited to single tenant with customer-facing interruption but rolled back. leaving oncall note and handing off.

ops-helen: monitoring shows stable request quality for ZenithPay after revert; no other tenants showing correlated signal in sweep. continuing 1h watch and then will clear.

cs-katie: scheduled bridge with ZenithPay CSM and engineering for 2026-03-15T06:00Z to go through details and next steps.

ml-eng-raj: next internal actions: add regression test using ZenithPay prompt corpus to quant CI, update rollout checklist to require per-tenant smoke on dedicated pools, and prepare q5_0_patch if needed.

eng-runtime-ana: incident log updated. handing off to oncall rotation. last_check 1798804920: all ZenithPay metrics within baseline thresholds.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-ZEN-02 -> MITIGATED. Follow-ups: RCA assigned, postmortem scheduled.
